bifrost: bifrost_app::usernotif (springboard/sdk/src/usernotif.rs), shell registry springboard/src/shell/usernotif.rs, delivery UI springboard/src/shell/notify/
summary: Local notifications are covered: categories with buttons, destructive and text-reply actions, requests with title, subtitle, body, thread, category, a time-interval delay and a Dock badge, removal and listing of delivered and pending requests, and the user's response (also queued for an app that is not running). Remote push (APNs, device tokens, background push, the notification service extension), calendar and location triggers, communication notifications, attachments, per-request sounds, notification settings queries and the foreground presentation delegate are not covered.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/usernotif.rs:225, springboard/src/bare/app_policy.rs:41; wired: springboard/src/shell/notify/permission.rs; springboard/src/shell/usernotif.rs (usernotif_hold, usernotif_ask_tick, usernotif_answer); springboard/sdk/src/usernotif_model.rs (AuthorizationStore, AuthorizationOptions, AuthorizationStatus, Settings)
features.note: Permission is a static manifest entry ("notifications"); there is no runtime prompt, no authorization options (alert, sound, badge) and no authorization status query. Without the permission every add answers NotPermitted. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 6 (0.5.44); verify on Midget for parity. Added: the authorization state machine (notDetermined to authorized, denied or provisional; asked once, persisted as text) and the settings snapshot. Model built and unit tested on the host (springboard/sdk/src/usernotif_model.rs); not yet wired to the shell wire protocol or the UI, so Midget check pending.

features.apple: UNUserNotificationCenter add, removeDeliveredNotifications, removePendingNotificationRequests, getDeliveredNotifications, getPendingNotificationRequests
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/usernotif.rs (add, remove_delivered, remove_pending, delivered, pending); springboard/src/shell/usernotif.rs (Registry); springboard/sdk/src/usernotif_model.rs (Sound, Attachment, CalendarTrigger, IntervalTrigger); springboard/src/shell/services/notification_schedule.rs; springboard/proto/src/rich.rs (NotifRequest); springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-04.rs (tests)
features.note: Covers add with identifier replacement, removal by identifier or all, and the delivered and pending lists; the add, remove, query and trigger rules are tested headless in springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-04.rs.Pending is capped at 64 per app (MAX_PENDING); A request now carries a per-request sound (default, named, critical), a bounded userInfo map (16 entries, 512 characters per value), an interruption level and a relevance score over the wire and in the notification-schedule service (springboard/proto/src/rich.rs, springboard/sdk/src/usernotif.rs). Delivery does not yet play the sound or return userInfo in the response. Added: UNNotificationSound validation (named, defaultCritical, critical volume), attachment validation by type and size, DateComponents calendar matching with DST handling (nextTriggerDate), repeating interval minimum of 60 s (enforced in the notification-schedule service). Model built and unit tested on the host (springboard/sdk/src/usernotif_model.rs); not yet wired to the shell wire protocol or the UI, so Midget check pending. Remote push and the service extension stay gaps. Round (notify-stacks): the request's thread is kept on the delivered notification (springboard/src/shell/usernotif.rs:380) and stacks per app and thread (springboard/src/shell/notify/store.rs:373 groups, :352 clear_thread). Not verified on Midget.

Taps and action buttons arrive as Event::Response, including text-reply text, and are queued when the app is not running. The Response fields, the default action and the foreground presentation rules are tested headless in springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-04.rs.No willPresent hook: the app cannot choose presentation options for a notification that arrives while it is in front. Added: the willPresent decision model (banner, list, sound, badge cut to the user's settings; no delegate shows nothing). Model built and unit tested on the host (springboard/sdk/src/usernotif_model.rs); not yet wired to the shell wire protocol or the UI, so Midget check pending.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/notification_schedule.rs (Trigger::Interval and Trigger::Calendar, Trigger::next_trigger_date, Trigger::validate, Schedule::checked_interval, Schedule::checked_calendar); springboard/sdk/src/usernotif_model.rs (CalendarTrigger, DateComponents, IntervalTrigger)
features.note: Host tests a_repeating_interval_under_a_minute_is_refused, a_daily_calendar_trigger_is_the_next_local_time_after_now and a_weekday_calendar_trigger_skips_other_days (sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-01e.rs). usernotif_model::CalendarTrigger matches year, month, day, weekday, hour, minute and second, follows the zone's offset at the fire time, and is tested headless in sdk/tests/parity_sdk-complete-44.rs (leap days, a year-pinned date, a weekday, an impossible component, a zone offset). Gap: the notification-schedule service's wire form still carries only hour, minute and weekday, so month, day and year triggers are not sent to the shell; a next-trigger query for a request already pending in the shell is not offered; location and push triggers need hardware or a service that does not exist here. Round (notify-stacks): pending interval and calendar requests are saved to pending-notifications.ini and restored on the first tick with their trigger times (springboard/src/shell/services/notification_schedule.rs: restore, persist, encode, decode; springboard/src/shell/usernotif.rs:124 pending_rows, :129 restore_pending). Host-tested with a fake clock across two shells (pending_requests_survive_a_restart_and_keep_their_trigger_times). Sound, userInfo and interruption level are not saved. Not verified on Midget.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. Wave 2 (user-notifications-ui, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No attachment API. Notification cards show text only. The shell has image drawing (springboard/render/src/imgdec, springboard/src/shell/notify/list.rs) that could carry an image thumbnail.

The SDK model holds the default, critical, critical-with-volume and named sounds and checks each against the grant (a critical sound needs the critical-alert grant, others the sound setting). Host tests sound_names_are_capped_at_255_bytes, critical_sounds_need_the_critical_alert_grant and critical_volume_must_be_between_zero_and_one (sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-01e.rs). Delivery does not yet play a per-request sound and the sound is not in the shell wire protocol; the only sound control in the shell is the per-app Sounds switch in Settings (springboard/src/shell/notify_page.rs, not cited for this evidence).

A badge number on a request and a short label on the dock icon are both available.

features.note: Entitlement and Apple-hosted testing tools belong to APNs. Nothing to match until remote push exists.

gaps: Remote push: no device token, no push registration, no background push wake-up (APNs or a BifrOSt equivalent).
Notification service extension: no hook to modify a notification before it is shown.
Calendar and location triggers: only a time-interval delay exists; no repeating or region-based notifications.
Attachments and per-request sounds: notification cards are text only and the sound is a per-app switch.
Runtime permission flow and settings query: permission is a manifest flag; there is no authorization status, no request options and no UNNotificationSettings equivalent.
Foreground presentation delegate (willPresent): an app cannot choose how a notification shows while it is in front.
Communication notifications and web push: no sender-based message notification and no Push API for the browser.
